routes.name: Iraq e-Visa
routes.summary: Official portal issues an electronic visa for single or multiple entry, valid 30 days. Eligible nationalities and fees are not listed on the page I could read.

other: Eligible nationalities not confirmed. Check the portal.
Valid passport and a digital photo with a white background.
Fees are paid online. Amounts not confirmed.

stay.note: Visa valid 30 days per the portal. Length of stay not stated.

steps: Fill in the online form on the official portal.
Receive the visa by email and print it for entry.

routes.name: Tourist and Visiting Visa
routes.summary: Under the residence law, a tourist visa allows one entry and a 30-day stay, no work. A visiting visa also allows 30 days. Groups usually need a licensed tourism company.

other: Passport valid at least 6 months, proof of funds, health clearance, no security or public health obstacle.
Individual and family tourists do not need a sponsoring company.
MOFA page is dated 2019 and mentions fees of 30 to 40 USD. Not confirmed as current.

sources.label: Iraq Ministry of Justice: Foreigners Residence Law No. 76 of 2017

routes.name: Regular (Normal) Entry Visa
routes.summary: One entry, stay up to 60 days under the 2017 law. Needed as the first step for most work and family stays.

other: Passport valid at least 6 months, proof of funds, stated purpose, Iraqi address and a guarantor.
Foreign workers generally need a Ministry of Labour work permit first.
The 2019 MOFA page says 3 months. The 2017 law says 60 days. Confirm with an Iraqi mission.

sources.label: Iraq Ministry of Justice: Foreigners Residence Law No. 76 of 2017

routes.name: Transit Visa
routes.summary: Transit visa allows one entry and up to 7 days. A non-stop transit visa covers crossing Iraq without stopping.

other: Airside transit rules not confirmed.

sources.label: Iraq Ministry of Justice: Foreigners Residence Law No. 76 of 2017

routes.name: Work Visa and Residence Card
routes.summary: Foreign workers need a work permit from the Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs, then a visa and a residence card, usually up to one year and renewable. An employer or guarantor is required.

other: Guarantor ensures the worker leaves when required. Changing employers needs approval of old and new guarantors.
Exceptions to the work permit exist for diplomatic missions, international organizations and some government contracts.
Kurdistan Region may run its own entry and residence rules. Not researched.

sources.label: Iraq Ministry of Justice: Foreigners Residence Law No. 76 of 2017

routes.name: Family, Study and Marriage Residence
routes.summary: One-year renewable residence for joining family, studying (including religious seminary), widows or divorcees of Iraqis, and spouses and children of Iraqis who hold foreign passports.

other: Renewal can be requested 30 days before expiry while the basis continues.

sources.label: Iraq Ministry of Justice: Foreigners Residence Law No. 76 of 2017

routes.name: Long-Term Residence (Article 21)
routes.summary: Renewable 3-year residence for people born in Iraq and still living there, 15 years of continuous residence, 6 years on a government contract, active investors, and spouses of Iraqis.

other: Born in Iraq and still residing there, or 15 years of continuous legal residence.
3 years of residence with a scientific, cultural or artistic contribution.
6 years or more under a government work contract.
Investors and businesspeople with active investments, or spouses of Iraqis while the marriage continues.
Absences up to 6 months a year do not break continuity.
The law does not use the term permanent residence. Citizenship rules not found on an official page.

sources.label: Iraq Ministry of Justice: Foreigners Residence Law No. 76 of 2017
